name: Founding
summary: One prompt launches the project. PRNG ported, comparison framework built, 126 special levels converted. Codex joins day 4. The insight: match every random number.

name: Measurement
summary: Session recording goes deterministic. Oracle test framework, git notes, 1000th commit. The shift from coding to measuring.

name: Porting Grind
summary: 73 CODEMATCH functions in one day. Watchdog agent learns to nudge. Human pushes back on test-only rules. Model switched to Sonnet for throughput.

name: Codex Sprint
summary: Codex agents drive CODEMATCH: animation, HP/PW/regen, mkmaze, throw/beam paths. 782 human messages on Feb 24. The porting gets broad but shallow.

name: Iron Parity
summary: Automated C-to-JS translator campaign. Batch-promotes hundreds of functions. Async revolution: 28 unawaited calls. Then declared unsuccessful. Pivot to direct parity fixes.

name: Expansion
summary: Rogue ported in a day. Hack matures. Cockatrice, steed, input overhaul. 44 LORE lessons on March 11. Six games running simultaneously.

name: Ecosystem
summary: Shell easter egg born. Rogue 84↙99%. Dungeon speedruns. Human: "do not avoid the difficult divergences." Switch to Opus. The project becomes a universe.

name: Convergence
summary: Logo from scratch. Reflections essay. seed031 cascade: 25 LORE lessons. Terminal unification. The project becomes self-aware.

name: Analysis
summary: The menace-agents project is born. 64 days of agent logs analyzed. 7 deep-dive studies. Dashboard and report built. The project becomes self-aware of its own patterns: agent avoidance, correction rates, infrastructure compounding.

name: Teleport
summary: Phase 1 complete Day 12: 100% RNG + 100% Events on 35 sessions. Phase 2 begins: sessions expand to 45 covering polyself, shops, alchemy, options menus. 6-agent swarm (Claude + Codex + Gemini). 2,955 commits, 149K LOC.

name: Wiring-Oversight Audits
summary: Waves III-V of wiring-oversight audits produce 60+ commits and 40+ LORE entries. Sherpa multi-segment keyplans + 'run-until' verb unlock bones round-trips. Session suite 45→82. Cleaver dominant (Opus 4.6→4.7 mid-project, no disruption). PROJECT_PLAN.md archived: agents now emergent, not plan-driven. Peak 211 commits (Apr 30, seed0030 closure).

name: Monk: The Readable Transpiler Counter-Experiment
summary: A third port launched May 5 with a different premise: could a readable-transpiler-first approach eliminate CODEMATCH-style hand-porting? Monk built a single-pass transpiler with a formal 7-class lowering-bug taxonomy (6 closed, 1 reverted). Reached 24/44 PASS on a frozen judge. Signature innovation: PRNG-index-aligned C recorder probes. But hit an architectural ceiling — cross-TU async coloring can't be resolved at single-TU scope. Latent translator fixes are stranded from the scored engine. A genuine methodology innovation and a genuine architectural indictment.

name: Autoascend Campaign: Fleet as Fuzzer
summary: Cleaver runs 88 pre-registered matrices (m1-m88) using the autoascend agent as both a productivity multiplier AND a fuzzer against the parity harness. 130-seed × 15k-step baselines land the fleet at 59 deaths / 130 sessions / 0 hard-stops / 43 depth-4+ / 49 median depth. Sokoban chain live end-to-end (first organic solve seed21 t1129). Phase 2 reactive playbooks hit a firm 104-death floor: architecture-limited, not tuning-limited. Estimation engine + oracle calibration refits HUNGER_BANDS and prayer cooldown estimators.

name: RTX (Reversible Transactions) Engine
summary: Xorn (Codex GPT-5.3-Codex-Spark) runs a continuous 26-day rollout dominantly on RTX engine work. 2,255 commits, 186 issues closed. Issue #825 Phase 1 (proxy-root journaling), #827 (setPrototypeOf/preventExtensions traps), #861 (occupation continuation journaling), #862 (replay-N Luck restoration), #865 (visual cache rollback consolidation). Scan-semantic findings driven to zero unmatched suppressions (Jul 9). Session channel model expanded from 3 to 4 (Cursor added). Verify-before-push discipline: 5-10 commits per day, each with 307/307 verification.

name: 500×100 Divergence Hunts as Steady State
summary: Random 500-session × 100-turn hunts become the daily rhythm. First-failure depth is the metric: when the tail is long, the port is done. Jul 7 sample: 22 actionable divergences in 500 sessions (4.4%). Jul 11: first-failure depths of 7, 32, 51, 112, 479 across consecutive hunts — the tail is lengthening. Rerecord.py + capture-truncation filter separates real divergences from recording artifacts. The steady-state measurement toward which the whole port has been driving.
